about: Media plan for public/data/news.json: a picture or video for every item. action add = the item has no image or embed today; upgrade = it has one, and a video would lead better; secondary = a video worth adding under today's lead; keep = nothing better found. choice youtube|photo|poster|none (keep/upgrade rows also use embed for items that keep a LinkedIn embed). Nothing here is applied to the site yet. YouTube 'published' is the watch page's uploadDate (Pacific time). 'checked' holds the HTTP status of every URL recorded (thumbnails and source pages included) on 2026-09-26, or the rclone size for Drive paths.
